action: Upgrade one secure WebSocket client without a certificate and one with a valid certificate, then send MQTT CONNECT on each.
config:
[listeners.wss]
enabled = true
bind = "127.0.0.1:28884"
cert_file = "${TLS_DIR}/server-cert.pem"
key_file = "${TLS_DIR}/server-key.pem"
verify_client_cert = true
cacertfile = "${TLS_DIR}/ca-cert.pem"
